sessionStart.bash: f="$COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT/references/GROUND-RULES.md"; if [ -r "$f" ]; then if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then jq -Rs '{additionalContext: .}' "$f"; elif command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node -e 'const fs=require("fs");console.log(JSON.stringify({additionalContext:fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8")}))' "$f"; fi; fi
